task_intent: Redesign Tessera arcade games and music service connections.

references.applied: A direct service action with concise supporting copy, flat section hierarchy and secondary connection details.
Actual account identity and connection state lead account management; destructive actions stay separate from the primary connection.
A restrained illustration of a personal music account reaching room hardware; integrated on the page rather than another popup.
One decisive connection action, strong heading and large deliberate breathing room, retaining Tessera's native typography.
PKCE S256, exact redirect and state validation, secret-free exchange, single-use cancellable authentication continuation.
Preserve refresh tokens when refresh omits a replacement; expired grants require explicit reauthorization instead of retry loops.
403 guidance distinguishes app-owner Premium requirements and listener allowlisting instead of incorrectly blaming every listener's subscription.
Avoid obsolete one-app quota claims; respect Retry-After and expose request limits without a retry storm.
Show the exact native callback address for setup; desktop authorization validates its explicit loopback path and state before accepting callbacks.
